name: OutSafe-Bench
description: OutSafe-Bench evaluates model behavior on potentially unsafe, adversarial, or out-of-scope prompts to measure refusal, safe-redirect, and policy-compliant responses. It tests both the classification of prompts as unsafe and the quality of generated safe responses when refusal or mitigation is required. The benchmark is intended to quantify safety-oriented behavior and robustness to harmful inputs.
reputation: A recent, specialized safety benchmark with modest community visibility focused on measuring refusal/safety behavior rather than broad adoption.
